content.short: Licensed by Hong Kong's SFC, HashKey Exchange lets users trade BTC, ETH and more directly in HKD and USD.
content.description: HashKey Exchange is HashKey Group's regulated venue for Hong Kong. It holds a licence from the Securities and Futures Commission, and users fund accounts by bank transfer to trade directly against Hong Kong or US dollars. Client assets sit in segregated, insured custody. The platform holds ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certification for information security and privacy. It holds Type 1 and Type 7 licences from the SFC and calls itself the largest licensed virtual asset exchange in Hong Kong.
content.meta: SFC-licensed Hong Kong exchange with HKD and USD pairs and segregated, insured custody. Explore HashKey Exchange on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
